chapter: Learning bass and Dew Drop days
title: Teaching himself bass from a book

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how

blocks.x: Yeah, well after I, see I never took bass at Greenwald School. Yeah, mostly self-taught there, you know. So what happened, after I finished that gig with Montra, Texas Lodge, I went on the road. But I didn't go out there playing bass. I went out there playing piano with Clyde and them, you know. And then when I come back, well, during the time when I was playing with Montra, I already had bought a book, you know, and the bass. So when I come back I went to practicing out the book, you know, and I learned how to fang it. I learned to correct fang. Because the first night I played with Montra, when I got off the job, my fingers wasn't only swollen, man. It was all hurting for the fang and it's wrong. Now I don't know about my earbringer, it might have brought out good sounds, but I'm talking about physically, feeling, man. So after I learned the correct fang, I went out the books and I learned to bore a little, you know, and I kind of got it together.
So you think you taught yourself correctly?
Yeah, yeah, the book, you know. I learned the position.
You teach yourself, you teach yourself wrong sometimes.
